help: Lightx2v's 4-step FL2V accelerator distilled together with SLA (Sparse-Linear Attention) at an 85% sparsity ratio. WanGP has no SLA backend, so the LoRA runs under normal attention: expect the same per-step cost as the plain v1.1 768p profile and none of the 2.5x speedup lightx2v measured in LightX2V. Keep it as a look alternative, not a speed setting. Sol-Attn is not a substitute - it is a different sparse attention and visibly moves the picture.
